enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +21: Passive: +21 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +6 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.
Charisma +10: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +10 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Alluring Skills Bonus: +9 Insight bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Haggle, Intimidate, and Perform.
Insightful Radiance +57: Passive: +57 Insight bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.
Insightful Radiance Lore +11: Passive: Your Light and Aligned spells gain a 11% Insight bonus to their chance to critical hit.
